findings_addressed.category: N8 existence-only for a behavior test
findings_addressed.oracle: The pattern source `_PRINT_PATTERN` declares `u8 __mark @ __ping();` — the real HexPat interpreter must return a field list containing a field whose name includes `__mark`. This is verified by inspecting the pattern AST independently: the `u8 __mark` declaration is the sole top-level typed variable, so any correct evaluation must emit exactly that named field. The `assert fields` plus `any('__mark' in name ...)` check uses the pattern source text as the independent oracle.
